author: CODEX SOL 6.1
membership: Trusted controller creates manifest from exact unchanged frozen records; question/gold IDs must join1:1 and visibility is explicit frozen metadata. No membership change, inferred split, duplicate/omit or replacement fixture.
exactlyOnce: One terminal accounting row per frozen item ID; attempts are child append-only records, never extra item rows. Atomic uniqueness on (runId,itemId), receipt hash and manifest bijection checked at closure.
classificationPrecedence: Retain orthogonal execution/scoring/quality axes. If item was stopped before invocation -> NOT_EXECUTED_AUTHORIZED_STOP; deadline exceeded -> TIMEOUT; execution infrastructure failure -> INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE; attributable product failure -> PRODUCT_LEVEL_FAILURE; valid execution but scorer fails -> SCORING_FAILURE; otherwise EXECUTED_SUCCESSFULLY even when semantic quality FAIL. Preserve secondary causes.
productVsInfrastructure: Provider/network/authority/adjudicator/capture/isolated-data failure is not automatically product-quality failure. Unknown cause remains explicit and quality UNRESOLVED.

completeness.fullyAccounted: All123 unique terminal rows join frozen manifest, counts49/50/24 and10/14 match, every attempt/retry retained, and all receipts verify.
completeness.fullyExecuted: All123 invoked; no NOT_EXECUTED_AUTHORIZED_STOP. Successful execution is a separate count from attempted execution.
completeness.fullyScored: All applicable dimensions/gates/reviewer outputs closed; no SCORING_FAILURE/UNRESOLVED.
completeness.passing: Separate gate and policy verdicts satisfied; never implied by fully accounted/executed. No aggregate metric.

interruption: After controller crash, reconcile attempts/raw output and synthesize explicit missing-output/infrastructure records; preserve crash receipt. No auto-resume/retry until authorized. If stop unauthorized, mark stop authority missing and run invalid, not lawful omission.
stop: Admission/startup run refusal can be recorded with123 NOT_EXECUTED_AUTHORIZED_STOP under the pre-bound fail-closed policy; no provider contacts. Do not create such run records in this authoring act.
